jointConstraints.rule: linkObj must contain exactly one of the url, bookmark, or method properties (the action to trigger); parameter and range may only be used together with method, and are ignored/inapplicable otherwise.

constraints: If a targetObj that already fully contains existing link(s) is re-linked, those existing links are removed and the new link is applied; a link that only partially overlaps targetObj is trimmed so the non-overlapping part keeps its previous link.
Setting a link on a targetObj spanning several paragraphs creates several separate links.
Only valid (encoded) URLs are accepted; an error is generated for an invalid link.
Links to 4D methods are removed when the document is exported to HTML, MIME HTML, or .docx format.
For a method-type link, the method must exist and be allowed via SET ALLOWED METHODS; it receives the 4D Write Pro area name in $1 and an object with method/parameter/range properties in $2.
